skipped.reason: Supplied data do not correspond to the c123 randomized PIT experiment. The 2025 stylistic-bias SAV has 6,958 rows and 16 columns: 240 idea records with IDs (30 labeled Model=0, human, and 210 labeled with 7 LLM sources, 30 per model), alongside 6,958 cosine-distance entries. Model identifies the source of an idea, not randomized ChatGPT assistance. Ocsai_LLM, Ocsai_Semantic, CAP_CLAUS, CAP_SemDis and their Humanized variants are automated scores, not the paper's expert PIT quality, elaboration or originality ratings. No participant-to-arm mapping, required expert ratings or prior-ChatGPT-experience variable is available. The SAV SHA256 (38cb0fe6d2a28ef99377a4f204cbd2965d64b44890c775d1fb6ab98a949a2fcf) matches the download manifest. The paper's 77 treatment people and 68 control people (PDF p. 11) cannot be reconstructed from these idea/model records. The paper reports individual assignment and no exclusions (PDF p. 10); there is no supported exclusion or aggregation that maps this SAV to those arms. PDF p. 16, Table 2, PIT quality: printed treatment M = 3.60, SD = 0.89; control M = 2.99, SD = 0.86; t(143) = 4.16; d = 0.69. There is no corresponding expert-rated quality variable or valid arm subset from which these statistics can be reproduced. No participant-level treatment-control statistics were computed. Direct lookups attempted during this audit at https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/rn62y/, https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/rn62y/files/osfstorage/, and the manuscript's named preregistration source https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/q6wtu/ all failed with URLError/WinError 10013 (socket access forbidden). No additional data were retrieved.
